bites.title: The paper moves, not you
bites.body: On a desk you slide, turn and lean over your paper all day. In Krita the view does that for you. Zoom, pan, rotate and mirror never change your painting, only how you look at it.

bites.title: Zoom
bites.body: Roll the mouse wheel over the canvas, tap + and -, or hold Ctrl+Space and drag the pen up and down. Get way in close.

bites.title: Pan
bites.body: Hold Space and drag with the pen. You're sliding the paper across the desk.
bites.hint: Middle mouse drag works too. Keep the pen over the canvas when you press Space.

bites.title: Turn the paper
bites.body: Hold Shift+Space and drag in a circle, or tap 4 and 6 to turn in steps. Painters turn their paper constantly so every stroke falls in the comfortable direction for their arm.

bites.title: Straighten up
bites.body: I just tipped your canvas. Press 5 to snap it back to level.

bites.title: The painter's mirror
bites.body:
Press {key:mirror_canvas|M}. Your drawing flips left to right.

Old masters checked their work in a hand mirror because a flip shows you mistakes your brain has stopped seeing. Do this every few minutes. Seriously.

bites.title: Lost? Number keys
bites.body: I zoomed you way in. The number keys are your compass: 1 = 100%, real pixels 2 = fit the whole page 3 = fit the width Try 2.
bites.hint: Also in the menu: View > Zoom. {key:zoom_to_100pct|Ctrl+0} is the menu shortcut for 100%.

bites.title: Canvas only
bites.body:
Press {key:view_show_canvas_only|Tab}. Everything vanishes, including me. Pure painting.

Press it again to bring me back.

bites.title: 02 cleared
bites.body:
Zoom, pan, turn, level, mirror, fit, hide. That's the whole desk.

Pro habit: mirror check every few minutes, turn the paper for every long stroke.
